q: Was war am 8. Mai 1945?
o: Ende des Zweiten Weltkriegs in Europa
Wahl von Konrad Adenauer zum Bundeskanzler
en: What happened on May 8, 1945?
oe: End of the Second World War in Europe
Election of Konrad Adenauer as Chancellor
Start of building the Berlin Wall

q: Was gab es während der Zeit des Nationalsozialismus in Deutschland?
o: das Recht zur freien Entfaltung der Persönlichkeit
en: What was there during the time of National Socialism in Germany?
oe: The right to free development of one's personality
x: The Nazis banned every party except their own NSDAP in 1933. Dignity, free personal development and press freedom are rights of today's Grundgesetz, which the Nazis abolished.

q: Was bezahlt man in Deutschland automatisch, wenn man fest angestellt ist?
en: What do you pay automatically in Germany if you pay a fixed ?
x: If you are employed, social insurance contributions (health, pension, unemployment, care, accident) are deducted from your pay automatically. The other three are benefits you apply for.

q: Wer darf bei den rund 40 jüdischen Makkabi-Sportvereinen Mitglied werden?
en: Who is allowed to participate in the approximately 40 Jewish Maccabi sports clubs Become a member?
x: The Makkabi sports clubs are Jewish clubs, but they are open to everyone, regardless of religion or origin.

q: Wie hieß der erste Bundeskanzler der Bundesrepublik Deutschland?
en: What was the name of the first Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany?
x: Konrad Adenauer (CDU) was the first Chancellor, from 1949 to 1963. Kiesinger, Brandt and Schmidt came later.

q: Was gehört nicht zur gesetzlichen Sozialversicherung?
en: What is not part of statutory social insurance?
x: Life insurance is a private, voluntary policy. The statutory social insurances are health, pension, unemployment, long-term care and accident insurance.

q: Deutschland ist Mitglied des Schengener Abkommens. Was bedeutet das?
o: Alle Menschen können ohne Personenkontrolle in Deutschland einreisen
Deutsche können in viele Länder Europas ohne Passkontrolle reisen

Deutsche können ohne Passkontrolle in jedes Land reisen

Germans can travel to many European countries without passport checks
Germans can pay with the euro in every country
Germans can travel to any country without passport checks
x: Schengen removed border checks between its member states, most of them in Europe. It is not about the euro, and it doesn't cover the whole world or non-Schengen travellers entering freely.

q: Wie endete der Zweite Weltkrieg in Europa offiziell?
o: mit dem Rückzug der Deutschen aus den besetzten Gebieten
en: How did the Second World War officially end in Europe?
oe: With the German withdrawal from occupied territories
x: The war in Europe officially ended with the Wehrmacht's unconditional surrender on 8 May 1945. Hitler's death a week earlier did not end it.

q: In welchem Jahr wurde Hitler Reichskanzler?

x: Hitler was appointed Reichskanzler on 30 January 1933. That date marks the start of the Nazi dictatorship.

q: Was gilt für die meisten Kinder in Deutschland?
en: What applies to most children in Germany?
x: Children in Germany must go to school (Schulpflicht), usually for 9 to 10 years. There is no duty to vote or to belong to a religion.

q: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?
en: Which country is a neighboring country of Germany?
x: Poland borders Germany to the east. Germany has 9 neighbours: Denmark, Poland, Czechia, Austria, Switzerland, France, Luxembourg, Belgium and the Netherlands.

q: Wann waren die Nationalsozialisten mit Adolf Hitler in Deutschland an der Macht?
en: When were the National Socialists with Adolf Hitler in Germany in power?
x: The Nazis ruled from Hitler's appointment in 1933 until the surrender in 1945.

q: Wer bezahlt in Deutschland die Sozialversicherungen?
en: Who pays for social security in Germany?
x: Social insurance contributions are split: roughly half comes from the employee's wage and half from the employer.

q: Das "Dritte Reich" war eine …
en: The "Third Reich" was a ...
x: The "Third Reich" (1933–1945) was the Nazi dictatorship: one party, no free elections, no separation of powers.

q: Frau Seger bekommt ein Kind. Was muss sie tun, um Elterngeld zu erhalten?

Sie muss nichts tun, denn sie bekommt automatisch Elterngeld

oe: She must ask the job centre for permission
She must write to her health insurer
She does nothing, she gets it automatically
She must apply at the parental allowance office

q: Welcher Krieg dauerte von 1939 bis 1945?
en: What war lasted from 1939 to 1945?
x: The Second World War began with Germany's attack on Poland on 1 September 1939 and ended in 1945.

q: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?
en: Which country is a neighboring country of Germany?
x: Switzerland borders Germany in the south (Lake Constance area, near Basel). Spain, Portugal and Hungary don't border Germany.

q: In welchem Jahr zerstörten die Nationalsozialisten Synagogen und jüdische Geschäfte in Deutschland?
en: In what year did the National Socialists destroy synagogues and Jewish businesses in Germany?
x: In the November pogroms of 1938 (9–10 November), the Nazis burned synagogues and wrecked Jewish shops across Germany.

q: Gewerkschaften sind Interessenverbände der …
en: Trade unions are interest groups of the ...
x: Trade unions represent workers. Employers have their own associations (Arbeitgeberverbände).

q: Was passierte am 9. November 1938 in Deutschland?
o: Die Nationalsozialisten verlieren eine Wahl und lösen den Reichstag auf
Jüdische Geschäfte und Synagogen werden durch Nationalsozialisten und ihre Anhänger zerstört
Mit dem Angriff auf Polen beginnt der Zweite Weltkrieg
Hitler wird Reichspräsident und lässt alle Parteien verbieten
en: What happened in Germany on November 9, 1938?
oe: The Nazis lose an election and dissolve the Reichstag
Jewish shops and synagogues are destroyed by Nazis and their supporters
The war begins with the attack on Poland
Hitler becomes president and bans all parties
x: 9 November 1938 was the pogrom night ("Reichspogromnacht"). The attack on Poland was in 1939.

q: Wann waren die Nationalsozialisten in Deutschland an der Macht?
en: When were the National Socialists in power in Germany?
x: The Nazi period ran from 1933 to 1945. 1888–1918 was the Kaiser's empire and 1949–1963 the Adenauer era.

q: Welche Lebensform ist in Deutschland nicht erlaubt?
o: Ein alleinerziehender Vater lebt mit seinen zwei Kindern zusammen.
Mann und Frau sind geschieden und leben mit neuen Partnern zusammen
Ein Mann ist mit zwei Frauen zur selben Zeit verheiratet
en: Which way of life is not allowed in Germany?
oe: A single father lives with his two children
A divorced man and woman live with new partners
A man is married to two women at the same time
x: Polygamy (being married to more than one person at once) is forbidden. All the other ways of living together are legal.

q: Claus Schenk Graf von Stauffenberg wurde bekannt durch …
o: das Attentat auf Hitler am 20. Juli 1944.
eine Goldmedaille bei den Olympischen Spielen 1936.
en: Claus Schenk Graf von Stauffenberg became known for ...
oe: The attempt on Hitler's life on 20 July 1944.
A gold medal at the 1936 Olympics.
x: Stauffenberg, an army officer, planted the bomb in the failed 20 July 1944 plot to kill Hitler. He is remembered as a symbol of resistance.

q: Wann war der Zweite Weltkrieg zu Ende?
en: When did the Second World War end?
x: The Second World War ended in 1945, in Europe on 8 May and in Asia in September.

q: Wer entscheidet, ob ein Kind in Deutschland in den Kindergarten geht?
en: Who decides whether a child in Germany is in the Kindergarten goes?
x: Kindergarten is voluntary in Germany, so the parents decide. School, by contrast, is compulsory.

q: Was kennzeichnete den NS-Staat? Eine Politik …
en: What characterized the Nazi state? A policy ...
x: The Nazi state was built on racism: Jews, Sinti and Roma and others were persecuted and murdered. It allowed no freedoms or democracy.

q: Was gab es in Deutschland nicht während der Zeit des Nationalsozialismus?
en: What did not exist in Germany during the time of the National Socialism?
x: Under the Nazis there were no free elections. Persecution, censorship and arbitrary arrests were all part of the regime.

q: Womit kann man in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland geehrt werden, wenn man auf politischem, wirtschaftlichem, kulturellem, geistigem oder sozialem Gebiet eine besondere Leistung erbracht hat? Mit dem …
en: What can you honour with in the Federal Republic of Germany political, economic, cultural, intellectual or social area has performed? With the ...
x: The Bundesverdienstkreuz is the Federal Republic's order of merit. The two other awards belonged to the GDR, and the eagle is the national coat of arms.

q: Die Nationalsozialisten mit Adolf Hitler errichteten 1933 in Deutschland …
en: In 1933, the National Socialists with Adolf Hitler built a Germany ...
x: In 1933 the Nazis abolished democracy and set up a dictatorship.

q: Wer baute die Mauer in Berlin?
en: Who built the Wall in Berlin?
x: The GDR built the Wall in 1961 to stop its citizens fleeing to West Berlin.

q: In welchem anderen Land gibt es eine große deutschsprachige Bevölkerung?
en: In which other country is there a large German-speaking Population?
x: German is the main language of Austria (and of much of Switzerland and Liechtenstein).

q: Bei welchen Demonstrationen in Deutschland riefen die Menschen "Wir sind das Volk"?
o: bei den Demonstrationen 1968 in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland
bei den Montagsdemonstrationen 1989 in der DDR
bei den Anti-Atomkraft-Demonstrationen 1985 in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland
en: At which demonstrations in Germany did people shout "We are the people"?
oe: At the 1968 demonstrations in West Germany
At the Monday demonstrations in the GDR in 1989
At the 1953 workers' uprising in the GDR
At the 1985 anti-nuclear demonstrations in West Germany
x: "Wir sind das Volk" ("We are the people") was the slogan of the peaceful Monday demonstrations in Leipzig and other GDR cities in autumn 1989.

q: Welche Länder wurden nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg in Deutschland als "Alliierte Besatzungsmächte" bezeichnet?
en: Which countries were renamed in Germany after the Second World War? referred to as "Allied Occupying Powers"?
oe: USA, Soviet Union, Great Britain, France
Soviet Union, Great Britain, Poland, Sweden
x: The four victorious powers that occupied Germany in 1945 were the USA, the Soviet Union, Britain and France.

q: Welchen Schulabschluss braucht man normalerweise, um an einer Universität in Deutschland ein Studium zu beginnen?
en: What school-leaving certificate do you normally need to take part in a University in Germany?
x: The Abitur (from the Gymnasium) is the normal university entrance qualification. A Diplom is a university degree, so you get it after studying.

q: Welches Land war keine "Alliierte Besatzungsmacht" in Deutschland?
en: Which country was not an "Allied occupying power" in Germany?
x: Japan fought on Germany's side in the war, so it was not an occupying power. The four powers were the USA, USSR, Britain and France.

q: Wann wurde die Bundesrepublik Deutschland gegründet?
en: When was the Federal Republic of Germany founded?
x: The Federal Republic was founded in 1949 when the Grundgesetz came into force on 23 May 1949.

q: Eine Frau in Deutschland verliert ihre Arbeit. Was darf nicht der Grund für diese Entlassung sein?
o: Die Frau kam oft zu spät zur Arbeit.
Die Frau bekommt ein Kind und ihr Chef weiß das.
Die Frau ist lange krank und arbeitsunfähig.
Die Frau erledigt private Sachen während der Arbeitszeit.
en: A woman in Germany loses her job. What is not allowed be the reason for this dismissal?
oe: She was often late for work.
She is having a baby and her boss knows.
She has been ill and unable to work for a long time.
She does private things during work hours.
x: Pregnant women and new mothers have special protection against dismissal (Mutterschutz). Being late often or doing private things at work can be reasons to fire someone.

q: In welcher Besatzungszone wurde die DDR gegründet? In der …
en: In which occupation zone was the GDR founded? In the ...
x: The GDR was founded in 1949 in the Soviet zone in the east. The three western zones became the Federal Republic.

q: Wann wurde die DDR gegründet?
en: When was the GDR founded?
x: The GDR was founded on 7 October 1949, a few months after the Federal Republic.

q: Wie viele Besatzungszonen gab es in Deutschland nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg?
en: How many occupation zones were there in Germany after the Second World War?
x: There were 4 occupation zones: American, British, French and Soviet.

q: Welche deutsche Stadt wurde nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg in vier Sektoren aufgeteilt?
en: Which German city was divided into four Sectors divided?
x: Berlin lay inside the Soviet zone but was split into four sectors, one for each Allied power.

q: Wer darf in Deutschland nicht als Paar zusammenleben?
en: Who is not allowed to live together as a couple in Germany?
x: Anne is 13, a child. Sexual relationships between adults and children under 14 are a crime. The age gap or same sex of the other couples doesn't matter.

q: Vom Juni 1948 bis zum Mai 1949 wurden die Bürgerinnen und Bürger von West-Berlin durch eine Luftbrücke versorgt. Welcher Umstand war dafür verantwortlich?
o: Für Großbritannien war die Versorgung über die Luftbrücke schneller.
Für Frankreich war eine Versorgung der West-Berliner Bevölkerung mit dem Flugzeug kostengünstiger.
Die Sowjetunion unterbrach den gesamten Verkehr auf dem Landwege.
Die amerikanischen Soldaten/Soldatinnen hatten beim Landtransport Angst vor Überfällen.
en: From June 1948 to May 1949, the citizens from West Berlin by an airlift. What circumstance was responsible for this?
oe: For Britain, supplying by air was faster.
For France, supplying by air was cheaper.
The Soviet Union cut off all land routes.
American soldiers feared attacks on land transport.
x: During the Berlin Blockade the USSR blocked all roads, railways and canals to West Berlin, so the Western Allies flew in supplies.

q: Viele Menschen in Deutschland arbeiten in ihrer Freizeit ehrenamtlich. Was bedeutet das?
o: Sie arbeiten in einem Krankenhaus und verdienen dabei Geld.
Sie arbeiten freiwillig und unbezahlt in Vereinen und Verbänden.

oe: They work in the federal government.
They work in a hospital and earn money.
They work voluntarily and unpaid in clubs and associations.
x: "Ehrenamtlich" means voluntary and unpaid, for example in sports clubs, the fire brigade or charities.

q: Der erste Bundeskanzler der Bundesrepublik Deutschland war …
en: The first Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany was ...
x: Konrad Adenauer was the first Chancellor (1949–1963). Erhard was second, and Brandt and Schröder came later.

q: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?
en: Which country is a neighboring country of Germany?
x: Denmark borders Germany to the north (Schleswig-Holstein). The other Nordic countries are across the sea.

q: Vor wie vielen Jahren gab es erstmals eine jüdische Gemeinde auf dem Gebiet des heutigen Deutschlands?

q: Ab welchem Alter ist man in Deutschland volljährig?
en: At what age do you come of age in Germany?
x: You come of age (volljährig) at 18 in Germany.

q: Wann war in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland das "Wirtschaftswunder"?
en: When was the "Economic miracle"?
x: The "economic miracle" was the fast recovery in the 1950s after the war, linked to Ludwig Erhard and the social market economy.

q: Woran erinnern die sogenannten „Stolpersteine“ in Deutschland?
o: an berühmte deutsche Politikerinnen und Politiker
en: What do the so-called "Stolpersteine" in Germany remind us of?
x: Stolpersteine are small brass plaques in the pavement outside the last homes of people persecuted and murdered by the Nazis.

q: Wen vertreten die Gewerkschaften in Deutschland?

q: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?
en: Which country is a neighboring country of Germany?
x: Luxembourg borders Germany in the west (Saarland and Rhineland-Palatinate).

x: On 17 June 1953 workers in the GDR rose up and were crushed by Soviet tanks. West Germany marked the day as a holiday until 1990.

q: Die Erziehung der Kinder ist in Deutschland vor allem Aufgabe …
en: In Germany, the education of children is above all a task …
x: The Grundgesetz (Art. 6) says raising children is first of all the right and duty of the parents.

Nur Personen, die noch nie im Gefängnis waren, dürfen wählen.

oe: You may accept money for voting for a certain candidate.
Voters may not be influenced or forced to vote a certain way, and voting may not harm them.
Only people who have never been in prison may vote.

q: Sie gehen in Deutschland zum Arbeitsgericht bei …

All parties that cleared the 5% hurdle.
The parliamentary group with the most MPs.
x: The opposition is every party in parliament that is not part of the government. Its job is to check and criticise the government.

q: Das Europäische Parlament wird regelmäßig gewählt, nämlich alle …
en: The European Parliament is regularly elected, namely: all ...

x: Parents are mainly responsible for bringing up their children (Grundgesetz Art. 6).

q: Wer wählt in Deutschland die Abgeordneten zum Bundestag?
en: Who elects the members of the Bundestag in Germany?
oe: The people who are entitled to vote
x: The members of the Bundestag are elected directly by the citizens who are entitled to vote.

q: Wann baute die DDR die Mauer in Berlin?
en: When did the GDR build the Wall in Berlin?
x: The GDR built the Wall in 1961 and it fell in 1989.

oe: The joining together of European states into the EU
A stop on immigration to Europe
x: "European integration" means European states growing together, economically and politically, in the EU.

q: In Deutschland dürfen Menschen offen etwas gegen die Regierung sagen, weil?
en: In Germany, people are allowed to openly do something against the government because?
oe: People have the right to vote.
x: Article 5 of the Grundgesetz protects freedom of opinion, so you may openly criticise the government.

q: Welches Gericht ist in Deutschland bei Konflikten in der Arbeitswelt zuständig?
en: Which court is responsible in Germany in the event of conflicts in the world of work?
x: Conflicts at work (dismissals, unpaid wages) go to the Arbeitsgericht.

q: Die Zusammenarbeit von Parteien zur Bildung einer Regierung nennt man in Deutschland …
en: The cooperation of parties to form a government is called in Germany ...
x: When several parties form a government together, it's a coalition (Koalition). A Fraktion is a party's group of MPs in parliament.

q: Wenn man in Deutschland ein Kind schlägt, …

kann man dafür nicht bestraft werden
en: If you hit a child in Germany, ...
oe: You can be punished for it
You cannot be punished for it
x: Children have the right to a non-violent upbringing (§1631 BGB). Hitting a child can be punished as assault.

q: Was bedeutet die Abkürzung DDR?
en: What does the abbreviation DDR mean?
x: DDR = Deutsche Demokratische Republik, the communist state in East Germany from 1949 to 1990.

q: Wer wird bei der Europawahl gewählt?
o: die Länder, die in die EU eintreten dürfen
en: Who will be elected in the European elections?
oe: The members of the European Parliament
The countries allowed to join the EU
x: In the European election, citizens elect the members of the European Parliament. The Commission is not directly elected.

q: Wie heißt das jüdische Gebetshaus?
en: What is the name of the Jewish house of prayer?
x: A synagogue is the Jewish house of prayer. A mosque is Muslim, and a church or basilica is Christian.

richtet sich nach der Nachfrage im Ausland.

q: Was ist keine staatliche Gewalt in Deutschland?
en: What is not state authority in Germany?
x: The three state powers are legislature, executive (government) and judiciary. The press is free and independent, sometimes called the "fourth power", but it is not part of the state.

q: Wann wurde die Mauer in Berlin für alle geöffnet?

q: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?
en: Which country is a neighboring country of Germany?

q: In Deutschland können Eltern bis zum 14. Lebensjahr ihres Kindes entscheiden, ob es in der Schule am?

q: Wie werden die Regierungschefinnen/Regierungschefs der meisten Bundesländer in Deutschland genannt?
en: How will the heads of government of most federal states in Germany?
x: The head of most state governments is the Ministerpräsident(in). Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen use (Erster/Regierender) Bürgermeister instead.

q: In Deutschland dürfen Ehepaare sich scheiden lassen. Meistens müssen sie dazu das "Trennungsjahr" einhalten. Was bedeutet das?

Visiting rights for the children last one year.

q: Welches heutige deutsche Bundesland gehörte früher zum Gebiet der DDR?
en: Which present-day German state used to belong to the area of the GDR?

q: Wo ist der Sitz des Europäischen Parlaments?
en: Where is the seat of the European Parliament?
